name: blutrixx/nativephp-sms
description: Default-SMS-app layer for NativePHP Mobile (Android): role request, receive/store/notify, send, read, blocklist. Phase 0 spike.

bridge_functions.name: Sms.GetStatus
bridge_functions.description: Role, permission, battery and device state in one call

bridge_functions.name: Sms.RequestDefault
bridge_functions.description: Open the system prompt to make this app the default SMS app; result arrives as the DefaultSmsResult event

bridge_functions.name: Sms.ListThreads
bridge_functions.description: Newest-first conversations from the system SMS store (needs READ_SMS)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.ListMessages
bridge_functions.description: Newest-first page of one conversation (needs READ_SMS)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.CountMessages
bridge_functions.description: Total rows in the system SMS store and how long counting took

bridge_functions.name: Sms.MarkRead
bridge_functions.description: Mark a conversation read (default SMS app only)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.Send
bridge_functions.description: Send a (multipart) SMS; mirrors it into the system store while default; sent/delivered arrive in the journal

bridge_functions.name: Sms.ListSims
bridge_functions.description: Active SIM slots and subscription ids (needs READ_PHONE_STATE)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.SetBlocklist
bridge_functions.description: Replace the native blocklist used by the headless receive path

bridge_functions.name: Sms.Configure
bridge_functions.description: Toggle the optional ephemeral PHP hand-off and the always-on keep-alive service

bridge_functions.name: Sms.DrainEvents
bridge_functions.description: Return the journal events the "drain" reader has not had yet, and acknowledge them (kept for older apps; use ReadEvents and AckEvents)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.OpenStore
bridge_functions.description: Open (and on first use create and migrate) sms.sqlite; returns its path and schema version

bridge_functions.name: Sms.ReadEvents
bridge_functions.description: Journal events after a cursor (after, or the last id a named reader acknowledged), oldest first; nothing is removed

bridge_functions.name: Sms.AckEvents
bridge_functions.description: Mark the journal as kept by a reader up to an event id; events every reader has kept are pruned after 14 days

bridge_functions.name: Sms.StartImport
bridge_functions.description: Start or resume the first-run import of the system SMS store into sms.sqlite (newest first); once done, copy only rows that are new

bridge_functions.name: Sms.ImportStatus
bridge_functions.description: The import progress: state (none, running, interrupted, done), done, total, oldest_ts, error

bridge_functions.name: Sms.VaultSetTestKey
bridge_functions.description: Debug builds only: seal the vault to a test public key (base64, 32 bytes) before vault setup exists

bridge_functions.name: Sms.BackupExport
bridge_functions.description: Save a backup file where the user picks; result as the DocumentResult event

bridge_functions.name: Sms.ExportReadable
bridge_functions.description: Save the normal texts as a readable zip; result as the DocumentResult event

bridge_functions.name: Sms.BackupPick
bridge_functions.description: Pick a backup file to restore; its header arrives as the DocumentResult event

bridge_functions.name: Sms.BackupRestore
bridge_functions.description: Restore the picked backup with the passphrase or recovery key

bridge_functions.name: Sms.BackupState
bridge_functions.description: Whether a backup can be made, and when the last file was saved

bridge_functions.name: Sms.VaultState
bridge_functions.description: {exists, open}: whether a vault is set up and open

bridge_functions.name: Sms.VaultSetup
bridge_functions.description: Make the vault with a passphrase; answers the recovery key once

bridge_functions.name: Sms.VaultUnlock
bridge_functions.description: Try a passphrase or the recovery key, always at the same cost

bridge_functions.name: Sms.VaultLock
bridge_functions.description: Lock the vault

bridge_functions.name: Sms.VaultChangePassphrase
bridge_functions.description: A new passphrase for the open vault

bridge_functions.name: Sms.VaultWipe
bridge_functions.description: Erase every vault message and the keys (open vault)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.VaultConversations
bridge_functions.description: The open vault conversations, one per number

bridge_functions.name: Sms.VaultMessages
bridge_functions.description: One vault conversation messages

bridge_functions.name: Sms.HideMessages
bridge_functions.description: Seal messages into the vault and remove them from conversations and the system store

bridge_functions.name: Sms.HideThread
bridge_functions.description: Hide a whole conversation

bridge_functions.name: Sms.VaultRestore
bridge_functions.description: Put vault messages back in a normal conversation

bridge_functions.name: Sms.VaultDelete
bridge_functions.description: Delete vault messages forever

bridge_functions.name: Sms.VaultDeleteConversation
bridge_functions.description: Delete a vault conversation forever

bridge_functions.name: Sms.VaultSend
bridge_functions.description: Send a text from the vault, kept only there

bridge_functions.name: Sms.Block
bridge_functions.description: Block a number, optionally moving its conversation into the vault

bridge_functions.name: Sms.KeepPrivate
bridge_functions.description: Keep a number in the vault (private), moving its conversation

bridge_functions.name: Sms.SetPrivateNotify
bridge_functions.description: A private number notifications: generic or silent

bridge_functions.name: Sms.MoveOutOfVault
bridge_functions.description: A private number back to normal, its messages restored

bridge_functions.name: Sms.Rules
bridge_functions.description: The blocklist and private numbers (open vault)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.AddRule
bridge_functions.description: Add a number, prefix, wildcard or keyword rule (open vault)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.RemoveRule
bridge_functions.description: Remove a rule (open vault)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.PrivateKeys
bridge_functions.description: Private numbers comparison keys

bridge_functions.name: Sms.ReportSpam
bridge_functions.description: Report a conversation as spam

bridge_functions.name: Sms.NotSpam
bridge_functions.description: A conversation is not spam

bridge_functions.name: Sms.PurgeSpam
bridge_functions.description: Delete spam conversations older than 30 days

bridge_functions.name: Sms.VaultSelfTest
bridge_functions.description: Debug builds only: libsodium round trip and Argon2id timing

bridge_functions.name: Sms.SaveThread
bridge_functions.description: Change a conversation in sms.sqlite: pinned, muted, folder (inbox, spam, archive), color, wallpaper, read

bridge_functions.name: Sms.DeleteThread
bridge_functions.description: Delete a conversation and its messages (and from the system store while default)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.DeleteMessage
bridge_functions.description: Delete one message (and from the system store while default)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.SaveTemplate
bridge_functions.description: Create or edit a saved reply (title, body, shortcut)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.DeleteTemplate
bridge_functions.description: Delete a saved reply

bridge_functions.name: Sms.SaveScheduled
bridge_functions.description: Create, edit or cancel a text to send later (thread_id or to, body, send_at)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.DeleteScheduled
bridge_functions.description: Delete a scheduled text

bridge_functions.name: Sms.SetSetting
bridge_functions.description: Set or remove one of the app's settings (keys under app.)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.SyncContacts
bridge_functions.description: Copy the phone contacts into sms.sqlite as names for numbers (needs READ_CONTACTS)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.Search
bridge_functions.description: Messages whose words match a query (each word or its start), newest first

bridge_functions.name: Sms.SetActiveThread
bridge_functions.description: The conversation now on screen: its texts post no notification (no id: none)

bridge_functions.name: Sms.TakePendingOpen
bridge_functions.description: The conversation a tapped notification asked to open, once

bridge_functions.name: Sms.TakePendingCompose
bridge_functions.description: Return and clear a compose request left by an sms:/smsto: link

bridge_functions.name: Sms.RequestBatteryOptimizationExemption
bridge_functions.description: Open the system battery-optimisation exemption prompt

bridge_functions.name: Sms.OpenAutostartSettings
bridge_functions.description: Open Phone Master's auto-start screen on Transsion phones, else the app's settings page

bridge_functions.name: Sms.OpenSettings
bridge_functions.description: Open the app's notification settings, auto-start screen or Android settings page

bridge_functions.name: Sms.RelayPair
bridge_functions.description: Pair with a browser from its scanned QR code

bridge_functions.name: Sms.RelayBrowsers
bridge_functions.description: The paired browsers and the relay connection state

bridge_functions.name: Sms.RelayUnpair
bridge_functions.description: Remove a paired browser here and on the relay

bridge_functions.name: Sms.RelaySelfTest
bridge_functions.description: Check the sync crypto against the browser test vectors
